_published_faq.name: How do I add Catchr MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Catchr MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.catchr.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Catchr MCP MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 15, 2026, Catchr MCP scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Catchr MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Catchr MCP provides these MCP tools: describe_run_api_request_schema, list_all_fields, list_available_accounts, list_fields_by_platform, list_fields_for_account, list_platforms, list_sources, and run_api_request_json.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Catchr MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Catchr MCP in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Catchr MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Catchr MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is Catchr MCP failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Catchr MCP scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is Authenticated MCP access is available. Reconnect the server account or provide a valid refreshable OAuth session, then rerun the audit. Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Catchr MCP is developed by Catchr. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
